description:
## Goal

Make activation coalescing express the full activation-key identity already enforced by every caller. Delete unreachable mutation paths rather than preserving misleading merge machinery.

## Proof at origin/main a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83

`CallSiteSummary::replace_targets_join_returns` and `CallSiteSummary::coalesce_targets` invoke `merge_callsite_activation` only after `same_call_target` has matched the callee and the complete `Option<ActivationKey>`. Nothing mutates an activation between that match and the helper call. The helper therefore receives only equal `Some` values or `None` values: its `Some` arm is a no-op, its `None/Some` assignment is unreachable, and its fallback is a no-op. The entire helper and both invocations are semantically inert.

`merge_target_activation` likewise contains a root/function-only path for different arrows even though its callers select candidates by the complete activation identity. That partial-key path cannot execute and would silently keep an arbitrary arrow if a caller ever loosened the match.

The already-built commit 1e7252981 demonstrates the intended deletion, but it is not present on this pinned main baseline.

## Change

- Delete both `merge_callsite_activation` invocations and the helper itself.
- Delete the unreachable partial-key path and mutation plumbing in `merge_target_activation`.
- Keep `same_call_target` keyed by callee plus complete activation identity.
- Preserve the existing surface-input, activation-input, and return joins.
- Add no shim, compatibility path, or explanatory dead-code branch.

## TDD and acceptance

- Focused callsite-summary tests cover repeated equal-activation snapshots.
- A different activation of the same callee remains distinct.
- Distinct-arrow activation keys remain distinct before the merge boundary.
- Arrival order cannot select which arrow survives.
- Repository search finds neither `merge_callsite_activation` nor a root/function-only activation merge.
- Full semantic tests, fixture matrix, formatting, and clippy with warnings denied pass.
title: Delete the inert callsite-activation merge and unreachable target partial-key branch
